speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked	the Minister for National Development (a) whether the Ministry can make public the results of all environmental impact assessments or studies done in relation to the development of Tengah; and (b) what are the plans for existing wildlife living in that area.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: NParks will separately study how to retain the existing greenery within the Forest Corridor, as well as to enhance it by introducing more native forest species.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Over time, this Forest Corridor is envisioned to be a lush habitat supporting the rich biodiversity.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: This is to minimise potential impact on wildlife within the development sites when works are in progress.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Can I check if there is a timeline for the baseline studies that the Minister of State mentioned and will we actually be doing an EIA or EIS instead?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Also, is MND or HDB working with any of the wildlife or nature groups with regard to this study?

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: Second, we are conducting an environmental baseline study because Tengah is made up of young secondary forests, scrubland, abandoned sundry cultivation like kampongs, farms and orchards, and old brickworks that were demolished in 2008.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: It was then used as a military training ground.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: Hence, we are conducting an environmental baseline study, together with other studies, as I have earlier mentioned.
